hospital-android-adb 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Automates full doctor appointment booking flow on the 医联 (Yilian) Android app using uiautomator2 only.
- Supports hospital search (Chinese input via set_text), department selection, schedule selection, and confirmation without Appium.
- Handles Chinese text input limitations and clickable parent detection in native Android layouts.
- Provides helpers for XML parsing of UI hierarchy and fallback OCR-based screen reading.
- Documents precise UI element access, technical constraints, and key implementation tips for robust automation.
